title: Export-share: vector filename keeps @2x
goal: On the export screen, choosing a format that has no pixel size still leaves a 2x size suffix in the suggested filename, which promises something the file will not have. This drops the suffix when it does not apply.
notes:
Objective: design-system > clickthrough-sweep. From study-tasks.json fix-export-share-scale. Verified still live 2026-08-22: picking SVG or PDF disables the scale seg but the scale variable stays 2, so filename() renders launch-poster@2x.svg. Reset scale to 1 (or exclude suffix for vector formats) when a vector format is picked.

Re-verified 2026-08-24 by reading docs/design/mocks/pages/export-share.html: the bug is real. `var fmt="png", scale=2` (line ~445); `suffix()` returns "@"+scale+"x" whenever scale>1 and `filename()` concatenates it unconditionally, so picking PDF or SVG renders launch-poster@2x.svg in both #fnPreview and #sFile. render() disables #scaleSeg for vector formats and the comment even says "disable + pin at 1x", but nothing pins it: the `scale` variable and the seg .on highlight both stay at 2. The API line also emits scale: 2 for a vector export.

Recoverable fix (do not mutate `scale`, acceptance item 2 needs the raster choice remembered): keep `scale` as the user's raster pick and add `function effectiveScale(){ return FMT[fmt].raster ? scale : 1; }`. Route suffix(), the w/h math, the est math and the apiExport string through effectiveScale(), and in render() set the seg .on highlight to data-scale="1" while locked, restoring it to `scale` when a raster format is picked again. Three acceptance items then check out by loading the page and clicking SVG then PNG.
acceptance: Choosing a resolution-independent format shows a suggested filename with no size suffix
Switching back to a pixel format restores the previously chosen size and its suffix

log.note: import triage: acceptance criteria and deps filled in from study-tasks.json + 2026-08-22 verification
